source: SCORING PLAN v2 §5 'G-3 and G-2 as a decision table' (carried unchanged by PLAN A10.1 §9; RECONCILIATION R-9 and N3). Floors are LOWER BOUNDS for the confirmed rulings (Q4/Q9: nodes malefic and numbered in full once 1401 is applied; nodes obstruct, node transits N/A); expectations, not measurements. A shortfall whose blank reasons are all allowed is REPORTED to the surrogate for a dispatch ruling; a reason outside the closed allowed set, or any forbidden reason, is a REFUSAL. Added to the closed allowed set by ruling SR-D6-OBJECTIVE-UNKNOWN (b): no_aspect_rule_defined_at_offset (BPHS 1:16496-16502 defines 3-10/5-9/4-8/7 only) is the named blank of a drishti operand at an offset the rule authority does not define; the generic objective_unknown_over_component stays OUTSIDE the set.

rows.basis: nodes fully numbered after 1401; remaining blanks are boundary/solver/dasha-horizon
Q9(i) nodes obstruct, node transits N/A; node residence coverage (V-3) unmeasured, so 85

caps.basis: INCONCLUSIVE (R-6) <= 0.5 % of windows; a breach predicts a seal refusal after a ~4 h build and the sharded verification. (I) INTERPRETATION: the INCONCLUSIVE reasons are the three named in PLAN A10.1 T15; windows carrying two of them are counted twice (an upper bound)

noninterference.note: GPT N3 / PLAN v2 G-7: at the same geometry configuration the sorted natural keys of windows, supports, contacts and membership equal the all-null baseline; only a rule-version identity change DECLARED in declared_rule_version_changes ({path, from, to, ruling}) is allowed; a declaration names its ruling ids (B.3), and any other change of rule version reads FAIL. NOT a version move, so not declared: the eight ND-H classes keep 1.2.0 and are re-derived IN PLACE (SR-NDH-INPLACE, SR-DOCTRINE-H); the identity 1.2.0 is on both sides, and its content change is the T11 check's, not G-7's.
